en: A monochrome postcard view of a large castle-like complex with round towers at both ends, high pitched roofs and small spires, set on a tree-covered embankment. In front of the castle is an open square or yard used as a timber market, with long stacks of cut wooden planks and a few workers walking around. Closer to the viewer stand several low wooden buildings, one with ornate decoration, another with a signboard on its facade. The scene has an early‑20th‑century feel.
